title: Filipino-Style Wild Pork Dinuguan with Leaves
description: A hearty and savory Filipino dish made with wild pork, herbs, and a rich, garlicky sauce, served with vibrant leaves.

ingredients.name: Filipino Vinegar
ingredients.notes: such as Sukang Iloko or vinegar of choice

instructions: 1. In a large pot, boil the wild pork shoulder in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
2. Drain the pork and set it aside.
3. In a blender or food processor, combine the garlic, patis, black pepper, savory salt, and dinuguan spice mix. Blend until smooth.
4. In a pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the blended mixture and sauté until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the vinegar and water to the pan, and stir to combine.
6. Add the cooked pork to the pan, and simmer the mixture for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Meanwhile, chop the fresh leaves and set them aside.
8. To serve, place a portion of the dinuguan on a plate, and garnish with chopped leaves.
10. Optional: Serve with steamed rice or a side of steamed vegetables.
